feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: How the U.S. focus on Iran is fueling a more aggressive Putin
entry.summary: Trump's top envoys head to Moscow and Kyiv as Putin steps up round the clock bombing of Ukraine. With the U.S. distracted by Iran, is Putin becoming increasingly emboldened?

entry.title: U.S. envoys in Moscow in new push for peace between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to revive efforts to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called for a halt to air attacks during their visit, but Moscow has not publicly responded.

entry.title: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest
entry.summary: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte has posted bail after order issued for her arrest on charges she publicly threatened to arrange assassination of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and two others.

entry.title: The U.N. backs a new world map showing Africa in its true relative size
entry.summary: The U.N. has backed a new map showing Africa in its true relative size, with the U.S. standing alone in opposition.

entry.title: Philippine vice president is ordered arrested for threats against the president
entry.summary: It's part of a political showdown with Marcos. A trial could impact her plans to run for president in 2028.

entry.title: Myanmar military head visits Vietnam to normalize relations
entry.summary: His trip to Vietnam marks his third visit to an ASEAN member state as he seeks to restore Myanmar's standing in the bloc.

entry.title: Trump asks SCOTUS to OK changes to mail-in ballots. And, diesel prices hit record high
entry.summary: Trump has asked the Supreme Court to lift the block on his plan for the USPS to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterm elections. And, diesel prices have reached a record high.

entry.title: Germany's far-right AfD party is poised for power in a state election
entry.summary: Germany's AfD's TikTok-fueled rise in Saxony-Anhalt is raising fears the country could see its first far-right governor since World War II.

entry.title: Russia intensifies attacks on Ukraine's capital
entry.summary: In Ukraine, a week of near-continuous Russian attacks is upending the lives of residents in Kyiv and its suburbs.

entry.title: Argentina escalates Falklands dispute with the U.K., seizing on Trump comments
entry.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei is escalating a dispute with Britain over the Falkland Islands with tougher sanctions targeting companies involved in a major offshore oil project.
